My Journey

I’m Ixhen — an iOS Tech Lead focused on building clean, reliable, and delightful mobile experiences. I enjoy shipping new features end-to-end, from architecture to UI polish.

Most recently I’ve been leading the Lamborghini Unica CarPlay app as the sole full-time iOS developer, with a strong focus on SwiftUI navigation, async/await architecture, and production-quality UX.
